The [claim graph](claimgraph.qmd) is the end state of a sequence of knowledge commits. Each one
states, adds a dependency to, proves, formalizes or refutes a claim. The timeline below replays them
in order, as a compact SVG figure. Drag the slider to see each claim's status as of every commit.

<iframe src="graph/history-timeline.html" title="Claim graph history timeline" loading="lazy"
        style="width:100%;height:560px;border:1px solid var(--bs-border-color,#dee2e6);border-radius:6px">
</iframe>

[Open the timeline on its own page](graph/history-timeline.html)

## Knowledge-commit log

The knowledge commits, oldest first. *Claims touched* lists the claims (by their `claims.toml`
slug) or the Lean declarations each commit asserted, closed or refuted. Plain feature, fix and
documentation commits carry no claim and are not listed; the full history is on
[GitHub](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver/commits/master).
